'''Mos Anek''' was an outpost of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{City-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Mos Anek was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. It appears as one of the Imperial settlements on the planet Tatooine.<ref name="TOR" />
